description: Doable workflows catalog — defines what can be automated in this ERP system and who is allowed to do it.

workflows.name: List All Warehouses
workflows.description: Fetches all warehouses and their details from the ERP system.

workflows.name: Get Purchase Orders
workflows.description: Retrieves all open or historical purchase orders from the ERP.

workflows.name: List Vendors / Suppliers
workflows.description: Fetches all registered vendors and supplier details.

workflows.name: Inventory Report
workflows.description: Generates a report of inventory levels across all warehouses.

workflows.name: List Employees
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of all employees in the ERP HR module.

workflows.name: Get Invoices
workflows.description: Lists all invoices, optionally filtered by status or date range.

workflows.name: Create Purchase Order
workflows.description: Creates a new purchase order in the ERP for a given vendor and items.

workflows.name: Update Inventory
workflows.description: Updates stock levels for a specific product in a warehouse.

workflows.name: List Customers
workflows.description: Fetches all customers registered in the ERP.

workflows.name: Payment Status Report
workflows.description: Retrieves payment statuses across all outstanding invoices.

role_notes.Platform Admin: Full access to all doable workflows including write operations.
role_notes.System Admin: Full access to read workflows; write operations allowed except destructive ones.
role_notes.Workflow Builder: Read-only workflows only. Cannot create, update, or delete records.
role_notes.Client: View-only access to orders and reports. No ERP data modification.
